The plugin then provides /foundry:* skills, its guard hooks, and the foundry-graph MCP, reading this workspace's corpus via CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
//gh-identity: Per-project gh identity isolation (OPT-IN, UL-0007): the PreToolUse guard blocks any gh command whose GH_CONFIG_DIR != the account declared in the NEAREST .claude/gh-identity (walking up from the command's cwd → ~/.config/gh-<account>). It is DORMANT until you create .claude/gh-identity, so single-account adopters are unaffected. Bootstrap an account once via .claude/hooks/gh-identity-bootstrap.sh; the resolved GH_CONFIG_DIR is exported by .envrc (direnv) or kept in gitignored settings.local.json. See docs/SETUP.md.
